profile.rule: A request can exercise compression only if max_tokens >= 512 and its live physical KV length reaches at least 9216 tokens. The total prompt plus generated-token budget is an upper bound, not proof of a commit. B1 server commit and worker acknowledgement logs are required to prove execution.
